name: Mining Sector
purpose: GRI 14: Mining Sector 2024 V1.1 provides information for organizations involved in mining activities about their likely material topics. These topics are likely to be material for organizations in the mining sector on the basis of the sector’s most significant impacts on the economy, environment, and people, including on their human rights.
